title: Careers
description: A list of open roles with an apply link each, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Badge, Button and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading, a sentence of introduction, then a title, a department badge, a location and a type per role, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — each role puts its apply link beside it at @sm, the heading steps up at @md and the section gets more room above and below at @lg.
